schemaDescription: Myntmore is hiring a remote freelance video editor to edit content for founders, CEOs, CXOs and industry leaders across technology, healthcare, manufacturing and other sectors. You will edit 60 to 90 second videos for Instagram and LinkedIn and 5 to 10 minute YouTube videos, and design a thumbnail for every video. The work includes strong hooks, pacing, storytelling, B-roll, captions, text animations, transitions and motion graphics. Turnaround is 2 days for short-form and 4 days for long-form videos. Pay is per video, settled at the end of every month.
aboutIntro:
Love turning raw footage into videos people actually want to watch?

At Myntmore, you'll get to work on content for founders, CEOs, CXOs, and industry leaders across diverse sectors, from technology and healthcare to manufacturing and beyond.

Every project brings a different personality, story, and creative challenge. We're looking for a freelance video editor who has a sharp creative eye, strong storytelling instincts, and knows how to make every second count.

responsibilities.title: Short-form videos:
responsibilities.desc: Edit 60–90-second videos for Instagram and LinkedIn.

responsibilities.title: Thumbnails:
responsibilities.desc: Design compelling, high-quality thumbnails for every edited video, aligned with the content and brand identity.

responsibilities.title: Storytelling:
responsibilities.desc: Turn raw footage into polished content with strong hooks, smooth pacing, and compelling storytelling.

responsibilities.title: Polish:
responsibilities.desc: Add relevant B-roll, captions, text animations, transitions, and motion graphics.

responsibilities.title: Range:
responsibilities.desc: Adapt your editing style to different personalities, industries, and brand identities.

responsibilities.title: Collaboration:
responsibilities.desc: Collaborate with our content team and incorporate multiple rounds of feedback.

whoYouAre.label: A creative eye:
whoYouAre.desc: Strong aesthetic sense, creativity, and attention to detail.

whoYouAre.label: Short and long form:
whoYouAre.desc: Experience editing short-form and long-form content.

whoYouAre.label: A storyteller:
whoYouAre.desc: Understanding of scripting, storytelling, visual flow, and audience retention.

whoYouAre.label: The right tools:
whoYouAre.desc: Familiarity with tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, VN, and Edits.

whoYouAre.label: Ownership:
whoYouAre.desc: Ability to take creative ownership rather than simply following instructions.

nonNegotiables.title: Timely delivery:
nonNegotiables.desc: Adhere to a turnaround time (TAT) of 2 days for short-form videos and 4 days for long-form videos. Meet agreed deadlines consistently and communicate any potential delays proactively.

nonNegotiables.title: Responsiveness:
nonNegotiables.desc: Be available for regular communication, feedback, and revisions during agreed working hours.

nonNegotiables.title: Feedback-friendly:
nonNegotiables.desc: Be comfortable with multiple rounds of revisions until the final output meets expectations.

nonNegotiables.title: Quality & consistency:
nonNegotiables.desc: Maintain high editing standards, accuracy, and brand guidelines across every project.

nonNegotiables.title: Availability:
nonNegotiables.desc: Have the capacity to take on recurring assignments and accommodate reasonable priority requests.

whyJoin: You'll work with different personalities, explore multiple industries, experiment with creative editing styles, and build a diverse portfolio of professional content. If you believe great video editing is about more than just cuts and transitions, we'd love to see your work!
